Title: Backend - BrandProfile Settings Exist, Are Public, and Round-Trip via Platform API
Preconditions: Store {{STORE_ID}} exists; valid Platform API OAuth2 token available
Test_Data: url={{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}}; settings group=Virto Commerce Frontend|Store Information
Steps:
[HTTP] GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}} with a valid Authorization Bearer token
[ASSERT] Locate the 'Virto Commerce Frontend|Store Information' settings group in the response Settings array
[ASSERT] Confirm all 7 XFrontend.BrandProfile.* settings are present: Description, Tagline, LogoUrl, ShareImageUrl, SameAs, ContactPhone, FoundingDate
[HTTP] PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores with each of the 7 BrandProfile settings set to a valid test value (Description=a short brand description string; Tagline=a short slogan string; LogoUrl=a valid absolute https image URL; ShareImageUrl=a valid absolute https image URL; SameAs=two valid absolute https company-profile URLs separated by a newline; ContactPhone=a phone number including country code, e.g. +1-800-555-0100; FoundingDate=a valid ISO calendar date, e.g. 2010-05-14)
[HTTP] Re-GET {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores/{{STORE_ID}}
Assertions:
[STATUS] Initial GET /api/stores/{id} returns HTTP 200
[STATUS] PUT /api/stores returns HTTP 204
[STATUS] Re-GET /api/stores/{id} returns HTTP 200
[BODY] All 7 BrandProfile settings are present in the settings group, each nullable and flagged public (IsPublic/equivalent)
[BODY] Re-GET response values for all 7 settings exactly match what was written in the PUT (SameAs preserved as the newline-separated string)
Failure_Signals: One or more of the 7 BrandProfile settings missing from the store settings group; setting not flagged public; PUT does not return 204; re-GET values differ from what was written
Cleanup: PUT the 7 BrandProfile settings back to their prior values (blank/null if none were configured before this test)

Title: Homepage Renders Exactly One JSON-LD OnlineStore Node With Correctly Mapped Fields
Preconditions: All 7 XFrontend.BrandProfile.* settings on {{STORE_ID}} are configured with valid values: Description, Tagline, LogoUrl, ShareImageUrl, SameAs (>=1 valid absolute http(s) URL), ContactPhone (with country code), FoundingDate (valid ISO date)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/ (homepage)
[WAIT] Wait for the page to fully render
[ACT] Open browser DevTools
[ACT] Locate the script[type='application/ld+json'] node(s) on the page
[ASSERT] Count the application/ld+json script nodes present
[ASSERT] Parse the JSON-LD content as JSON
[ASSERT] Inspect @context, @type, @id, name, url, logo, description, slogan, sameAs, contactPoint, foundingDate fields
Assertions:
[DOM] Exactly one script[type='application/ld+json'] node is present on the homepage
[FORMAT] The JSON-LD content parses as valid JSON with no errors
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD @context equals 'https://schema.org' and @type equals 'OnlineStore'
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD @id equals '<page origin>/#organization'
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD name and url fields are present and non-empty
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD logo field present and equal to the configured LogoUrl value
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD description field present and equal to the configured Description value
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD slogan field present and equal to the configured Tagline value
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD sameAs array present and containing the configured SameAs URL(s)
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD contactPoint present with @type 'ContactPoint', telephone equal to the configured ContactPhone, and contactType 'Customer Service'
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD foundingDate field present and equal to the configured FoundingDate value
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] GET {{FRONT_URL}}/ returns HTTP 200
[CONSOLE] no JSON parse errors from structured data / no TypeError
Failure_Signals: JSON-LD script node absent from the homepage; more than one JSON-LD OnlineStore node present; any mapped field (logo/description/slogan/sameAs/contactPoint/foundingDate) missing or not matching the configured BrandProfile setting; JSON parse error on the ld+json content
Cleanup: none - read-only verification against settings configured in SD-001

Title: Site-Wide OpenGraph Tags Present on Homepage With og:image Sourced From ShareImageUrl
Preconditions: XFrontend.BrandProfile.ShareImageUrl (and the other BrandProfile settings) on {{STORE_ID}} configured with valid values, as in SD-002
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/ (homepage)
[WAIT] Wait for the page to fully render
[ACT] Open browser DevTools Elements panel
[ACT] Inspect the <head> section
[ASSERT] Locate og:site_name, og:type, og:url, og:image meta tags
[ASSERT] Locate og:title and og:description meta tags (page/CMS-owned, not asserted against BrandProfile values)
Assertions:
[DOM] meta[property=og:site_name] is present and non-empty
[DOM] meta[property=og:type] is present with content=website
[DOM] meta[property=og:url] is present and matches the current page URL/origin
[DOM] meta[property=og:image] is present with content equal to the configured ShareImageUrl value
[DOM] meta[property=og:title] and meta[property=og:description] are present (values are page-owned and may legitimately differ from BrandProfile Tagline/Description - do not assert equality, that override is by design)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] GET {{FRONT_URL}}/ returns HTTP 200
[CONSOLE] no console errors related to meta tag rendering
Failure_Signals: og:image missing or not sourced from ShareImageUrl; og:type not equal to website; og:site_name or og:url missing; test incorrectly flags og:title/og:description not matching brand Tagline/Description (that mismatch is by design, not a defect)

Title: JSON-LD sameAs Validation - Relative Path, Non-HTTP(S) Scheme, and Duplicates Dropped
Preconditions: Other 6 BrandProfile settings on {{STORE_ID}} remain valid (as in SD-002); this case temporarily overrides only SameAs
Test_Data: SameAs input list (5 entries, one per line): a valid absolute https company-profile URL; the SAME URL repeated (duplicate); a relative path /about-us; a non-http(s) scheme URL ftp://example.com/profile; a second, different valid absolute https company-profile URL
Steps:
[SETUP] PUT {{BACK_URL}}/api/stores with XFrontend.BrandProfile.SameAs on {{STORE_ID}} set to the 5-entry bad list described in Test_Data
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/ (homepage)
[WAIT] Wait for the page to fully render
[ACT] Open browser DevTools
[ACT] Locate the script[type='application/ld+json'] node
[ASSERT] Parse the sameAs array from the JSON-LD content
Assertions:
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD sameAs array present and containing exactly the 2 distinct valid absolute http(s) URLs from the input, deduplicated
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD sameAs array does not contain the relative path '/about-us'
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD sameAs array does not contain the 'ftp://example.com/profile' URL
[DOM] parsed JSON-LD sameAs array present with no duplicate entries
[FORMAT] The JSON-LD content remains valid JSON despite the bad input
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] GET {{FRONT_URL}}/ returns HTTP 200
[CONSOLE] no JSON parse errors from structured data / no TypeError
Failure_Signals: sameAs includes the relative path or the ftp:// URL; duplicate entries not collapsed; the JSON-LD node is missing entirely or malformed; sameAs array is empty even though valid URLs were present in the input
Cleanup: PUT XFrontend.BrandProfile.SameAs on {{STORE_ID}} back to its valid pre-test value (the value configured in SD-002)

Title: JSON-LD contactPoint Omitted When ContactPhone Lacks Country Code or Has an Extension

[ACT] Open browser DevTools

[ASSERT] Parse the JSON-LD content and check for the contactPoint key
Assertions:

[DOM] parsed JSON-LD all other fields (name, url, logo, description, slogan, sameAs, foundingDate) remain present and unaffected

Title: Structured Data Page Gating - JSON-LD Present Only on the Homepage (Default and Localized), Absent Elsewhere
Preconditions: All 7 BrandProfile settings on {{STORE_ID}} configured with valid values (as in SD-002); storefront has at least one non-default locale configured alongside the default (e.g. de) and at least one non-homepage catalog page reachable
Test_Data: urls: {{FRONT_URL}}/ ; {{FRONT_URL}}/de/ (or the storefront's actual configured secondary locale code if 'de' is not configured); {{FRONT_URL}}/catalog ; {{FRONT_URL}}/agent-test-nonexistent-route-sd007 (a route that does not exist)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/ (default homepage)
[ASSERT] Count application/ld+json nodes and capture the @id value
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/de/ (localized homepage, or the store's actual secondary locale)
[ASSERT] Count application/ld+json nodes and capture the @id value
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/catalog (a non-homepage page)
[ASSERT] Count application/ld+json nodes
[ASSERT] Verify site-wide OpenGraph tags (og:site_name, og:image) are still present
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/agent-test-nonexistent-route-sd007 (non-existent route)
[ASSERT] Count application/ld+json nodes
Assertions:
[DOM] homepage {{FRONT_URL}}/ has exactly 1 script[type='application/ld+json'] OnlineStore node present
[DOM] localized homepage {{FRONT_URL}}/de/ (or the store's secondary locale) has exactly 1 script[type='application/ld+json'] OnlineStore node present, whose @id is identical to the default homepage's @id
[DOM] {{FRONT_URL}}/catalog has script[type='application/ld+json'] nodes absent (0 nodes)
[DOM] meta[property=og:site_name] and meta[property=og:image] are still present on /catalog (site-wide OG fallback is unaffected by JSON-LD gating)
[DOM] the non-existent route (404 page) has script[type='application/ld+json'] nodes absent (0 nodes)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] GET / and /de/ return HTTP 200; GET /catalog returns HTTP 200; the non-existent route's response status is not asserted (SPA soft-404 vs true 404 both acceptable) - assert only on JSON-LD absence
[CONSOLE] no JSON parse errors from structured data
Failure_Signals: JSON-LD node present on /catalog or on the non-existent route; localized homepage missing the JSON-LD node or its @id differs from the default homepage's @id; default homepage has 0 or more than 1 JSON-LD nodes
